body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant exception); outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**: semantic anchor rule (bound anchor elsewhere invalidates ANY giver answer incl. cell targets).
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: "Bring {thing} and {verb}" for sites lacking a thing the pawn's level has (build/install/refuel).
- **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY**: every order reads as base game — replace disabled vanilla row, inherit orderInPriority + target icon, Default priority.
- **SEAMLESS CONTINUATION DOCTRINE**: every arrival continuation self-heals (bring-and-X payload+retry; generic ABPendingOrders idle-gated 18t retry; think-node routers re-run; JobDrivers self-contained).
- **CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD (2026-07-23)**: while locked, ALL automatic level switches blocked at the Game.CurrentMap setter (stairs ride-along AND selection/jump). Manual switches via JumpPreservingView set ManualSwitch to bypass; cross-level order machinery writes currentMapIndex directly. Column-scoped.
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art; risers host atlases. Climb animations vanilla pipeline. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).
- **IsPlayerHome column identity** (ColumnAsHome): pocket levels report the ground map's home verdict (stands down inside AlertsReadout scope + QuestGen). This is load-bearing for hauling-mod compat — Hauler's Dream gates its enhancements on map.IsPlayerHome, so it runs on our sky/basement for free.

## 2026-07-23 — HAULING MOD COMPAT (Scope B: bulk spans levels, single-carry fallback) — BUILT, compile green, needs test
User asked to support Allow Tool priority hauling, Hauler's Dream, and Pick Up And Haul; chose deep scope (bulk inventory hauling actively spans levels) with the single-item carry as fallback when those mods are absent.
- **ABInventoryHaulBridge** (Source/Compat): reflection-only bridge to PUAH (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul) + Hauler's Dream (giwaffed.HaulersDream). Resolves each mod's `CompHauledToInventory` type + `RegisterHauledItem` + static `PawnUnloadChecker`. `AnyActive`, `HasComp(pawn)`, `Register(pawn,thing)`, `RequestUnload(pawn)`. Cached once; broken-flag per system on first throw → falls back. No foreign types in any signature (sidesteps the dev-palette signature-scan trap).
- **CrossLevelHaulJob.Build**: shared decision. Bulk (bridge active + pawn has comp) → gather seed + nearby same-destination stacks (radius 12, cap 16, stop ~0.8 encumbrance) into an AB_BulkHaulAcrossLevels job. Else single AB_HaulAcrossLevels (unchanged vanilla-feel carry).
- **JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels**: extract-next-from-queue loop → goto → SplitOff min(stack, CountToPickUpUntilOverEncumbered) into inventory + Register into host comp → loop until queue empty or ~0.8 encumbrance → goto stairs → climb → StairTransfer.Transfer (inventory rides the despawn) → RequestUnload (host mod stores on arrival level, which reads as home). Bails cleanly if nothing was liftable.
- **WorkGiver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels** (Hauling, prio 10): active only when bridge active + pawn has comp. Existing single-item WorkGiver_ABHaulAcrossLevels now stands down for those pawns (exactly one fires). Robots/mechs lack the comp → keep single carry.
- **Allow Tool priority hauling**: ABAllowToolCompat resolves HaulUrgentlyDesignation by name. WorkGiver_ABHaulUrgentlyAcrossLevels (Hauling, prio 100) carries urgently-designated stacks whose better storage is cross-level FIRST (bulk when a bridge is active, single otherwise). Fills the gap where Allow Tool's own same-map-only urgent giver returned null (Alert_NoUrgentStorage nag + drift at ordinary priority). Designation clears via Allow Tool's own PlaceHauledThing patch.
- Reused crossLevelHauling setting (no new toggle). Migration probe unchanged — PUAH/HD givers stay in the probe (they signal their own cross-level work; their JobOnThing is guarded by their own code, no level-graph recursion). Our new givers are namespace AsAboveSoBelow so IsOwnCrossLevelGiver already skips them in probes.

## EARLIER 2026-07-23 highlights (verification rolling)
Camera level lock upgraded to hard. Deep compat + seamless scan; generic ABPendingOrders idle-gated retry. Full P1+P2 parity batch: trade beacons column-wide; refuel/vat demand + forced order; transporter manifests; surgery-bill ingredients; baby food; mech recharge routing; gear probes; non-Ideo gatherings; detectors roof/childcare/mech-repair. Install/uninstall parity + auto ferry; robot bounce fix (probe-gated) + StationElsewhere; container-storage push fix; Achtung drags; construction supply giver + bring-and-build; jobs settings tab; biome-driven plateaus; climb animations + wide stairs.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API. Forced cross-level refuel USER-VERIFIED; Robots++ crossing verified.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; jobs tab: presets + cadence sliders + 5 flow checkboxes.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified crossing; probe-gated + StationElsewhere). **Hauler's Dream + Pick Up And Haul (bulk inventory hauling spans levels via ABInventoryHaulBridge; single-carry fallback). Allow Tool priority hauling (urgent stacks cross first).** Achtung! drags (soft). Reverse Commands (column colonists, self-heal). Giddy-up / Vehicle Framework (routing exclusions). Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (UI, fail-open). All inert without host. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: hauling-mod compat built (Scope B bulk-across-levels + single fallback + Allow Tool urgent). Compile green — relaunch owed to verify: bulk pickup+ride+unload on both PUAH and HD, urgent cross-level carry, and single-carry fallback still fires for robots/no-comp pawns. Plus the prior lock-while-clicking, generalized continuation, and parity circuit. Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
